protocol.value: open-loop cumulative prediction: each model receives only the first 3s observed history, then the next input window is updated with its own predictions until the strict avoidance endpoint.
470 hold-out 0409 samples consistent with the HGB-ECR fixed-3s validation set.

Errors are computed every 0.5s after the input window and additionally at the strict avoidance endpoint; endpoint is the earlier of stabilized lane/deceleration completion and 10s total trajectory duration.
Observed-update rolling metrics are not used here because they refresh the model with later true observations and therefore are not pure full-trajectory prediction metrics.
